review_candidates.description_excerpt: IT Systems Administrator America’s Test Kitchen and Food52 are seeking an IT Systems Administrator to join the Information Technology team in order to support, maintain, and elevate our core infrastructure and technology services. This position is ideal for a versatile technologist who thrives on a blend of user support, hybrid systems administration, and strategic project work. Key Responsibilities Systems & Infrastructure Administration: Maintain, upgrade, and optimize virtualization platforms
eligibility_evidence: In this role, you will manage a dynamic hybrid environment encompassing end-user hardware and support, cloud services, virtualization, networking, security, and specialized high-performance storage tailored for our media and video production teams.
This position is ideal for a versatile technologist who thrives on a blend of user support, hybrid systems administration, and strategic project work.

Key Responsibilities Systems & Infrastructure Administration: Maintain, upgrade, and optimize virtualization platforms, hybrid cloud services, backup/archiving solutions, networking, and enterprise storage—including high-performance media storage used in video production.
Hybrid Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience administering Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems in a hybrid enterprise environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Qualifications 3-5+ years of experience in IT Systems Administration, Systems Engineering, or IT Operations. Hybrid Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience administering Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems in a hybrid enterprise environment. Virtualization & Infrastructure: Hands-on administration of hypervisors (VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix) and enterprise network/Wi-Fi stacks (Cisco, Meraki, Juniper, Ruckus). Preferred Qualifications Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (or equivalent practical experience), alongside relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, Network+, CCNA, Microsoft, AWS, VMware, or other).
